purpose: Master specification for generating consistent hand-illustrated Piku sprite sheets (3 animations x 6 frames = 18 sprites per animated sheet; 6 single-frame illustrations per static sheet) so automated slicing, background removal, alignment, and app integration work reliably.

characterStyleLock.silhouette: Soft, slightly imperfect rounded mochi-orb body (subtle hand-drawn organic curve, slightly fuller near the base). Never a sterile geometric circle.
characterStyleLock.lineArt: Consistent warm dark brown (#473527) hand-drawn medium-weight outline with rounded stroke ends. Never pure black (#000000). Keep stroke thickness consistent across all 18 cells.
characterStyleLock.sprout: Centered at top crown: short dark brown stem branching into two small pointed oval green leaves tilting left and right.
characterStyleLock.face: Minimalist centered slightly above mid-body: two widely spaced dark brown dot/oval eyes and a tiny curved smile. Open happy/winking mouth shows soft coral-peach (#E99482).
characterStyleLock.limbs: Short thin dark brown stick legs with tiny outward-pointing feet. Stick arms stay hidden/tucked during calm resting poses (idle, blink, sleep) and emerge only for expressive gestures or props.
characterStyleLock.groundingShadow: DO NOT draw ground shadows under Piku. The app renders a dynamic soft shadow on the Canvas so Piku looks clean on both light and dark Windows wallpapers.

animated_3x6.description: 3 animations per image, 6 frames per animation = 18 characters total.
animated_3x6.readingOrder: Each row is one complete animation. Frames run strictly left-to-right: Col 1 = Frame 01 through Col 6 = Frame 06.

recommendedImageSizePx.aspect3x2Note: If your image generator only outputs 16:9 or 3:2 (e.g., 1536x1024 or 2752x1536), keep 3 equal-height rows and 6 equal-width columns with generous white margin around every character so the slicer can partition by uniform grid.

background.preferred: Solid flat pure white (#FFFFFF) — zero paper texture, zero cream backdrop, zero drop shadows, zero rounded boxes behind frames.

cellSafeMargins.rule: No sprout tip, waving hand, spark, or zZ letter may cross into an adjacent cell or touch the outer edge of its cell. Keep body scale identical across all 6 frames of a row.

static_2x3.description: 6 single-frame static illustrations per image (2 rows x 3 columns).

background.preferred: Solid flat pure white (#FFFFFF) or transparent RGBA PNG — no cards, boxes, or shadows.

labelingConvention.primaryIdentification: Exact filename matching each sheet's `filename` field below (e.g., `art-source/raw-sheets/sheet_01_core_calm.png`).

inImageLabelMode.explanation: Best extraction quality comes from having ZERO text inside the sprite cells and relying on the exact filename + row order (Row 1, Row 2, Row 3). If you want visual labels on the sheet so you can review them easily, use the optional margin-strip rule below.

optionalLabeledLayout.animatedSheets: Reserve a thin 48px-tall label strip at the TOP of each row (or a 180px-wide column on the far LEFT outside the 6 sprite columns) containing ONLY the exact lowercase ID (e.g. `R1: idle`, `R2: blink`, `R3: sleep`). Keep all label text strictly outside character cells with at least 24px white gap.
optionalLabeledLayout.staticSheets: Place the exact lowercase ID centered in a thin 48px strip directly BELOW each illustration's cell with at least 24px white gap.
neverDo: Never write text overlapping Piku's sprout, feet, sparks, or zZ marks.
Never draw colored pill boxes or thick borders touching the sprite cells.
Never mix two different animations in the same row.

animatedSheets.purpose: Regenerate core resting animations (replaces current programmatic placeholders).

animations.label: R1: idle
animations.appTrigger: Default ambient desktop breathing state.
frameGuide: F1: Neutral canonical rest pose, relaxed smile, feet planted, arms tucked.
F2: Subtle inhale start — body lifts slightly taller, sprout leaves perk upward slightly.
F3: Inhale peak — body tallest/softly buoyant, sprout leaves gently open.
F4: Exhale start — body eases back toward neutral.
F5: Soft exhale settle — gentle mochi squash (slightly wider/lower), sprout dips slightly.
F6: Return smoothly toward neutral F1 for seamless loop.

animations.label: R2: blink
animations.appTrigger: Random natural blink every 3.5–7.5 seconds while idle.
frameGuide: F1: Neutral eyes open (matches idle F1).
F2: Eyelids half-closed gently.
F3: Eyes softly closed in cute curved `u u` shut arcs, slight relaxed dip.
F4: Closed-eye hold (subtle cozy cheek lift).
F5: Eyes half-opening smoothly.
F6: Eyes fully open back to neutral (matches idle F1).

animations.label: R3: sleep
animations.appTrigger: Idle sleep mode, paused tracking, or late-night nap.
frameGuide: F1: Melted squishy mochi puddle resting low, peaceful closed eyes, small `z` near top-right.
F2: Gentle slow breath expand, `z` floats slightly higher.
F3: Soft breath peak, second `Z` appears floating above.
F4: Slow breath deflate, `z Z` drifts upward-right.
F5: Deep cozy puddle squish, top `Z` fades/shrinks.
F6: Gentle settle back toward F1 for seamless nap loop.

animatedSheets.purpose: Regenerate core interactive reactions (replaces current programmatic placeholders).

animations.label: R1: wave
animations.appTrigger: Greeting panel open, app launch hello, friendly ambient check-in.
frameGuide: F1: Neutral body, right arm begins lifting out to side.
F2: Arm raised cheerfully, happy smile, slight lean left.
F3: Wave peak — arm tilted outward with 2–3 tiny golden sparks (#F2C94C).
F4: Arm swings slightly inward (friendly back-and-forth wave).
F5: Second cheerful wave out with tiny golden sparks, sprout bobs happily.
F6: Arm lowers cleanly back to neutral.

animations.label: R2: happy
animations.appTrigger: Opening Today view, positive delight moment.
frameGuide: F1: Cute anticipation crouch/squish before jumping, big smile.
F2: Takeoff — lifting off baseline, both little arms lifting, joyful open mouth.
F3: High airborne hop peak — feet off ground, arms up, joyful `^ ^` eyes, golden sparks.
F4: Descending gently from hop, sprout leaves trailing slightly upward.
F5: Soft mochi landing squash on baseline, happy cheeks.
F6: Settle smoothly upright back to neutral.

animations.label: R3: click
animations.appTrigger: Direct left-click poke on Piku on the desktop.
frameGuide: F1: Instant poke contact — bright startled-cute `> <` eyes, slight tilt.
F2: Deep playful mochi squish wide and flat, `> w <` face, tiny golden pop marks.
F3: Rebound stretch upward preparing to spring.
F4: Cute little spring pop off the ground with joyful smile and sparks.
F5: Soft landing bounce settle.
F6: Return cleanly to neutral rest.

animatedSheets.purpose: Warm positive emotional expressions for greetings, hover, and milestones.

animations.label: R1: excited
animations.appTrigger: First active session of the day or milestone celebration.
frameGuide: F1: Perky upright posture, wide sparkling eyes, open happy mouth.
F2: Quick excited wiggle left with tiny golden sparks around sprout.
F3: Mini tip-toe bounce up with both tiny arms raised.
F4: Quick excited wiggle right with sparks.
F5: Mini tip-toe bounce with winking joyful face.
F6: Cheerful settle back to neutral.

animations.label: R2: content
animations.appTrigger: Calm steady work rhythm or cozy evening ambient moment.
frameGuide: F1: Peaceful gentle sway left, soft curved closed eyes, warm smile.
F2: Tiny pastel coral heart (#E99482) pops near top-right.
F3: Gentle sway right, heart floats slightly higher.
F4: Heart reaches gentle peak, sprout tilts lovingly.
F5: Sway centers, heart softens/shrinks gently.
F6: Eyes open peacefully back to neutral.

animations.label: R3: blush
animations.appTrigger: Hovering over Piku for a moment or repeated gentle clicks.
frameGuide: F1: Soft rosy blush ovals (#F5B8B0) appear on both cheeks, shy smile.
F2: Tiny bashful tilt left, arms tucked close near chin.
F3: Shy wiggle right, happy curved eyes, warm blush glow.
F4: Bashful mini-squish with cozy smile.
F5: Slight stretch back upright, blush still visible.
F6: Blush fades gently back to neutral.

animatedSheets.purpose: Curious, attentive, and startled expressions for live desktop responsiveness.

animations.label: R1: curious
animations.appTrigger: Ambient curiosity check-in or returning after short absence.
frameGuide: F1: Eyes shift slightly right, tiny sprout perk.
F2: Cute head/body lean right, small dark brown `?` appears at top-right.
F3: Lean deepens slightly, eyes widen curiously, `?` bobs up.
F4: Hold curious tilted pose, sprout leaves lean playfully.
F5: Ease back upright, `?` shrinks away.
F6: Return to neutral smile.

animations.label: R2: thinking
animations.appTrigger: Ambient pondering moment while user works steadily.
frameGuide: F1: Eyes glance up-right, tiny mouth turns into thoughtful little `o` / flat curve.
F2: One tiny stick arm lifts near cheek in pondering pose.
F3: First tiny thought dot appears top-right, subtle lean.
F4: Second and third tiny thought dots (`...`) float gently.
F5: Slight nod of realization, sprout perks.
F6: Arm tucks away, back to warm neutral smile.

animations.label: R3: surprised
animations.appTrigger: Waking suddenly from sleep or abrupt desktop activity.
frameGuide: F1: Sudden tiny vertical stretch, wide eyes, tiny `o` mouth.
F2: Quick little startled hop with 2–3 golden `!` sparks around sprout.
F3: Peak startled hold, tiny arms flailed out slightly.
F4: Soft landing, eyes blinking in relief.
F5: Gentle sheepish smile settle.
F6: Return smoothly to neutral.

animatedSheets.purpose: Focused work posture, pre-sleep yawn transition, and playful drag-in-air loop.

animations.label: R1: focused
animations.appTrigger: Long uninterrupted work session (> 25 minutes active focus).
frameGuide: F1: Cute tiny determined eyebrows, steady calm upright posture.
F2: Gentle focused lean slightly forward/sideways.
F3: Subtle steady breathing lift, sprout straight and attentive.
F4: Focused hold with tiny confident smile.
F5: Gentle exhale settle.
F6: Smooth return to F1 for calm focus loop.

animations.label: R2: yawn
animations.appTrigger: Cozy transition right before Piku settles into sleep or late at night.
frameGuide: F1: Droopy half-closed sleepy eyes, slight downward slouch.
F2: Mouth opens into cute round yawn (`o`), tiny arms stretch upward.
F3: Full cozy yawn peak — eyes tightly shut happy-sleepy, sprout stretches tall.
F4: Yawn eases down, soft coral mouth closing.
F5: Big sleepy exhale, body softens lower toward puddle.
F6: Heavy-lidded cozy droop ready to enter sleep.

animations.label: R3: drag
animations.appTrigger: While the user is actively dragging Piku across the desktop.
frameGuide: F1: Lifted slightly in air, feet dangling/kicking gently left, curious-surprised smile.
F2: Tiny arms waving slightly for balance, feet kick right.
F3: Gentle sway right, sprout leaves fluttering back.
F4: Cute `o` / delighted expression, feet dangling left.
F5: Gentle sway left, tiny arms out.
F6: Return smoothly toward F1 for playful air-dangle loop.

animations.label: R1: moment_working

F3: Right paw taps keyboard, subtle happy lean.

F5: Brief glance up happily over the laptop screen.

animations.label: R2: moment_break

F3: Bounce up-center, music note floats higher.
F4: Gentle head-bob down-right, second tiny note appears.

animations.label: R3: moment_late_night
animations.appTrigger: Ambient moment after 10:00 PM local time. Bubble: 'Getting late, sleepyhead 🌙'
frameGuide: F1: Piku wrapped snugly inside a soft lavender blanket (#C7B8F0), only face & sprout peeking out.
F2: Gentle cozy inhale inside blanket, sleepy blinking eyes.
F3: Subtle sleepy nod forward.
F4: Peaceful soft smile, sprout tilts drowsily.

workflowAfterGeneration: 1. Save your generated PNG sheets into `art-source/raw-sheets/` using the exact `filename` for each sheet (e.g., `sheet_01_core_calm.png`).
2. Start with Priority P0 (`sheet_01_core_calm.png` and `sheet_02_core_reactions.png`) so we can immediately test slicing, alignment, and hot-swap the 6 core runtime animations.
3. Drop in P1 (`sheet_03`..`sheet_05`), P2 (`sheet_06`..`sheet_08`), and P3 (`sheet_09`..`sheet_10`) whenever ready.

4. Once placed in `art-source/raw-sheets/`, we will run an updated `3x6` / `2x3` sheet extractor, strip white backgrounds, defringe outlines, align every frame cleanly, validate via `validate_assets.py`, and wire all new expressions, moments, and static states into Piku.
